description.narrative: The project aim is to enhance community resilience in vulnerable communities in Morocco by increasing anticipation and promoting responsive, effective governance, thereby preventing community susceptibility to violent extremism. Disenfranchised individuals and groups will increasingly change their life paths to advance economically and socially, and increasingly evolve in environments that foster ownership of the community by its inhabitants
